Domestic supply is therefore not confirmed and not refuted — null, not invented.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: outbound shipments from Mundra Sea to Kenya (Jinja), South Africa (Jinja) and Colombia (Buenaventura) between 2025-12-15 and 2026-01-27, with BOL numbers 7899113, 7998333, 8037134, 9093457. Declared HS 401390 is consistent with the observed 40139020 (butyl inner tubes) line, so no HS correction is needed; note the company also ships rubber compounds (40012200, 40059910) and engine oil (27101989), i.e. it is a multi-product tyre/tube maker-trader rather than a pure 401390 exporter. The company is also an active importer (used rubber extruder from Qingdao, China, BOL 6702203), which supports a real manufacturing operation. Role reads as manufacturer_trader. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts (696) but no values, and no financials were reachable. Domestic (India) supply evidence: not found in accessible sources; this is a data-access gap, not a negative finding, and should be re-checked against GST/GeM when those portals are reachable. No sanctions/court issues were assessed here (out of scope for this role).
